posts.author_bio: Veterans in Business works to support veteran entrepreneurs and those in the workforce by providing support and resources to grow our community.
posts.author_name: Veterans In Business By The Fruita Area Chamber of Commerce
posts.post_caption:
We had a great time at our recent Veterans in Business (VIB) Monthly Muster, hosted at Veteran-owned Aspen Street Coffee in Fruita. It was a wonderful morning filled with camaraderie, networking, and stories. A big shoutout to American Legion Post 2006 for continuing to be our annual sponsor for VIB. 

Supporting veteran entrepreneurs and those in the workforce is incredibly important. With over 18,000 Veterans in Mesa County, the Fruita Area Chamber of Commerce (FACC) recognizes the significant role the Veteran community plays in our business ecosystem. Veterans bring unique skills, leadership, and dedication that are vital to our economy and community.

Veterans in Business by the FACC meets monthly on the 3rd Wednesday of each month at rotating locations. We are excited to announce that next month's event will be an after-hours gathering at Cameo Shooting and Education Complex on August 14. You can register online at events.fruitachamber.org

A special thanks to the amazing veteran-owned businesses that joined us this month: Cruise Planners - Todd & Sonee Kumro, Raven & Wolf Benefits, Ignus Arms, Panini Junction, Trail Cookie, and Grand Junction Lifestyle Magazine. Your contributions to our community are invaluable!

Thank you to everyone who attended and supported this event. We look forward to seeing you next month!
